qa_pairs.question: What specific information does the "Coeur CPU gaspillé" graph display for Alliance users in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: For Alliance users, the "Coeur CPU gaspillé" graph in the Metrix portal, located within the CPU accounts section of Account statistics, shows the CPU cores wasted by each user over time.

qa_pairs.question: Where can an Alliance user find a visual representation of wasted CPU core usage per individual within their group on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: An Alliance user can find a visual representation of wasted CPU core usage per individual within their group on the Metrix portal under the "CPU accounts" section of the "Account statistics." This graph illustrates the CPU cores wasted by each user over time.
